description: This file contains helper functions and classes for working with OECD data, including custom HTTP session handling, data fetching, XML parsing, caching mechanisms, and date conversions.

classes.name: CustomHttpAdapter
classes.description: A custom HTTPAdapter for requests that allows setting a custom SSL context.

methods.name: get_legacy_session
methods.description: Creates and returns a custom requests.Session with a legacy SSL context.

methods.name: fetch_data
methods.description: Fetches OECD data from a URL and returns it as a pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: oecd_xml_to_df
methods.description: Parses OECD XML data into a pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: parse_url
methods.description: Fetches and parses data from a URL into a DataFrame.

methods.name: check_cache_exists_and_valid
methods.description: Checks if a cache file exists and is valid for the current day.

methods.name: write_to_cache
methods.description: Writes a DataFrame to cache in parquet or CSV format and records the date.

methods.name: query_dict_to_path
methods.description: Converts a query dictionary into a string suitable for filenames.

methods.name: get_possibly_cached_data
methods.description: Retrieves data from cache if valid, otherwise fetches from URL and caches it.

methods.name: oecd_date_to_python_date
methods.description: Converts OECD date formats to Python date objects.
